bindings.comparison: The prerelease derivation explicitly identifies H1(O) as the lattice-cocycle quotient (a,b)->b-aZ and computes the Kodaira–Spencer class from the translations z_j=z_i+Z e_j. It gives the rank through exact tensor-factor maps, with the harmless overall minus sign arising from the declared Čech-boundary convention. The independent residue matrices B0 and I both have determinant1; the program certifies the full determinant identity and the analytic leading-value argument proves invertibility on the small punctured disc. Every named family is bound to its own exact multiplicative or marked-additive construction; no isomorphism between different global families is assumed. The complete printed proof agrees except for its explicit false name “flat” for the holomorphic extension frame e_i,f_i. The source connection and exact triangular change of basis resolve that error; the proposed proof retains the same log matrix and rank conclusion. All primary proposition numbers were compiled and visually checked, and the official version-specific TeX members are byte-identical to the attached construction sources.
